name: dlfs
description: Manage the owner's decentralised lattice filesystem drives: list or create drives, browse, read, write, organise, mount or delete DLFS content. Load when a named drive, replication or WebDAV matters.

content.inline:
# DLFS drives

DLFS provides named, signed, lattice-backed filesystems with convergent merge semantics. Replication and secrecy are different properties.

List drives first. Within a drive, list or tree to navigate; use stat before acting on an uncertain path. `create` refuses replacement, `write` creates or overwrites, and parent directories must exist. Read `v/info/adapters/dlfs/webdav` when asked how to mount a drive.

Creating or deleting a drive changes durable state, and deleting a drive removes all of its contents. Deleting a non-empty directory uses the operation's recursive option. Report the drive and paths changed.
